title: calendar.upcoming
description: Fetches the next N events from now (future-only, sorted by start time). Default limit is 5, clamped to max 20. On first invocation, macOS prompts the user for Calendar access permission. If permission is denied, returns {available: false, reason: 'permission_denied'}. If no upcoming events exist, returns {available: false, reason: 'no_events'}.

limit.description: Number of upcoming events to return. Default 5, clamped to 1-20.
